title: ClearPath personal loan
subtitle: Relatively transparent · fixed rate
description: A fully synthetic agreement with explicit amounts, a fixed rate, modest fees, and a stated grace period.
text:
SYNTHETIC DEMONSTRATION DOCUMENT — NOT A REAL OFFER
ClearPath Mutual Bank
PERSONAL LOAN AGREEMENT

This synthetic personal loan agreement is between ClearPath Mutual Bank and the borrower.

Principal amount: $12,000.00.
Loan term: 36 months.
Repayments are due in monthly instalments on the first business day of each month.

The fixed annual interest rate is 7.20% per annum. The interest rate is fixed for the entire agreement.
The effective annual rate is 7.44%, as explicitly disclosed for this synthetic example.

Account maintenance fee: $3.00 per month.
Processing fee: $75.00 one-time at origination.
There are no administrative fees under this agreement.

A late payment fee of $15.00 applies if a payment remains unpaid after a grace period of 10 calendar days.
Early repayment penalty: 0%. The borrower may repay early without an early repayment charge.

Optional payment protection insurance costs $6.00 per month and may be cancelled by the borrower.
Domestic bank transfers from the repayment account have a transaction fee of $0.25 per transaction.

The final repayment includes any remaining principal and accrued ordinary interest. The bank will provide a complete amortisation schedule upon request.

This document is synthetic and created only to demonstrate document analysis. It is not financial advice or an actual financial product.

title: HarbourStone consumer credit
subtitle: Multiple additional fees · synthetic
description: A fully synthetic fee-heavy agreement with recurring maintenance, mandatory insurance, penalties, and discretionary charges.
text:
SYNTHETIC DEMONSTRATION DOCUMENT — NOT A REAL OFFER
HarbourStone Finance
PERSONAL LOAN AGREEMENT AND FEE SCHEDULE

This synthetic credit agreement is issued by HarbourStone Finance.

Loan principal: EUR 8,500.00.
Repayment period: 48 months.
The borrower must make monthly payments on the 15th day of each month.

The annual interest rate is 9.40% per annum. The interest rate is fixed for 48 months.

Loan processing fee: 3.00% of principal, one-time and deducted from loan proceeds.
Documentation and administrative fee: EUR 120.00 one-time at signing.
Monthly account maintenance fee: EUR 11.90 per month for keeping the account open.
Mandatory credit protection insurance premium: EUR 14.50 per month throughout the agreement.

A transfer commission of 0.80% applies to each transfer from the loan servicing account.
An additional handling fee of EUR 4.00 applies per withdrawal at a branch.

Late payment penalty: 6.00% of the overdue instalment, plus a default charge of 0.08% per day on the overdue balance.
Early repayment fee: 2.50% of the outstanding principal when early settlement occurs.

The provider may introduce other charges from time to time at its sole discretion. Additional service fees may apply as determined by the provider.

A payment holiday may be granted at our discretion; interest accrues during any payment holiday and the repayment schedule may be extended.

All names, values, and clauses in this document are synthetic and provided solely for software testing and financial-literacy education.

title: AsterPeak variable-rate loan
subtitle: Variable interest · early repayment
description: A fully synthetic agreement with benchmark-linked interest, adjustment conditions, early settlement charges, and a final balloon payment.
text:
SYNTHETIC DEMONSTRATION DOCUMENT — NOT A REAL OFFER
AsterPeak Capital Finance
VARIABLE-RATE PERSONAL LOAN AGREEMENT

This synthetic agreement is between AsterPeak Capital Finance and the customer.

Principal amount: $20,000.00.
Contract duration: 60 months.
Repayment frequency: monthly instalments.

The initial annual interest rate is 5.75% per annum.
This is a variable rate. The interest rate equals the six-month SOFR reference rate plus a margin of 2.75%.
The provider may adjust the interest rate every six months following a benchmark review. Rate changes may increase or decrease monthly instalments.
The agreement does not state a maximum interest-rate cap.

Origination fee: $200.00 one-time at origination.
Account management fee: $5.50 per month.

Early repayment penalty: 3.00% of the amount repaid early during the first 24 months.
After 24 months, the early settlement fee is 1.00% of the amount repaid early.
Late payment fee: $35.00 for each instalment more than 5 days late.

A balloon payment of $2,500.00 is due at maturity in addition to the final ordinary monthly instalment.
Borrowers must maintain a repayment account with the provider for the full contract duration.

Other costs payable on demand may apply at our discretion without notice.

This document is entirely synthetic. Benchmark names are used for educational illustration only and this is not an actual offer or financial recommendation.
